idea-plugin.name: Git Workflow Enforcer
idea-plugin.description:
Git Workflow Enforcer

Consistent Git workflows shouldn't rely on code review. Git Workflow Enforcer validates branch names, commit messages, and merge policies before commits happen — ensuring every team member follows the same rules automatically.

Key Features

  • Branch Naming Rules — Enforce Gitflow, trunk-based, or custom naming conventions
  • Commit Message Validation — Validate format, length, and conventional commit compliance
  • Merge Policies — Configure allowed merge strategies per branch
  • Pre-Commit Validation — Block non-compliant commits with clear error messages
  • Status Bar Indicator — Visual compliance status always visible
  • Team Config — Share rules via .git-workflow.yaml in the repository

Why Git Workflow Enforcer?

Manual enforcement of Git conventions doesn't scale. This plugin makes compliance automatic and frictionless, reducing code review churn and keeping your Git history clean.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: Branch naming enforcement, commit message validation, status bar indicator, team config
  • Pro: Custom regex patterns, merge policy enforcement, workflow analytics, compliance reports, and integration with CI/CD pipeline gates
